steps.text: Come, Rosalind, let's learn how to pray to Kjeragandr.
Close your eyes, put your hands before your chest, and call out Kjeragandr's name silently in your heart...
Good job, Rosalind.
You're Mama and Papa's sweetheart, Rosalind.
Mama could never regret giving birth to you, no matter what people might say.
May Kjeragandr bless...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The Kjeragandr looks even bigger up close.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So that's what She looks like.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Pray... to Kjeragandr...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What did Mamochka teach me again?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No, I can't remember. I mean, it all happened before I was three.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I guess I should start praying—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Close my eyes... what do I do with my hands again?
Stretch your right palm out flat and place it before your chest.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: In Kjeragandr's presence, we close our eyes that do not truly see, and bow our overly proud heads.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Drive stray thoughts from our minds, and recite Kjeragandr's name in our hearts.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Come, child, after me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Okay!
Leto closes her eyes again.
Her vision goes dark, but her senses seem to vastly expand in an instant.
Behind her, the old devotee begins to praise Kjeragandr's name in his raspy voice.
Kjeragandr, grant us springs that quench our thirst, and fruit that sates our hunger.
Kjeragandr, grant us ice and snow that freeze Catastrophe.
Kind and gentle Kjeragandr, watch over us and Kjerag.
The sensation of wind brushing past her cheeks seems to grow with the chanting, the snowy wind roaring in her ear.
A sense of familiarity, rising from a place that Leto does not know, takes her down memory lane.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Kjeragandr...)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (I'm not your follower, and I don't need your blessing.)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (But if you really do protect your believers, please, protect Mamochka.)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (I wouldn't have come if she didn't ask me to.)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hm, no, that's not good enough.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Kjeragandr—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Please, protect my mother! She's a devout follower of yours!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She told me how great Kjerag is! I'll see how great it is for myself!

steps.name: Surprised Tourist
steps.text: What's that about?

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: Is that what Kjerag prayers are like?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ok, that's good.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What are you doing, girl?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Praying, of course.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I mean, it's better to pray aloud, isn't it? Make sure Kjeragandr can hear me.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Don't want to leave behind any regrets, you know!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, and thanks for teaching me!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Well, I suppose Kjeragandr is hardly one to be picky about petty details...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: No need to thank me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Kjeragandr sounds like a pretty nice lady!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Just like you, batyushka.
Leto removes her hand from her chest and takes one last look at the imposing Kjeragandr statue, before turning around to descend the steps.
The old devotee sees her face clearly for the first time.
The visage before his eyes, under the sunlight...
The curves of her cheeks, the height of her nose, the shape of her lips...
A sense of familiarity washes over the old man.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: It's... you... You're...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: No, it's nothing...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I've seen plenty of tourists in my time, but no one who's done what you did.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Really? Did I do something weird?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Rosalind. It's Rosalind.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Rosalind...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: How old are you, Rosalind?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Me? Almost twenty.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Are you Kjerag?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You can tell?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You look like...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Yes, you really do...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, you called it. I was born here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But I spent my whole life in Ursus. This is my first time back.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I guess only half of me is Kjerag.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You grew up in Ursus?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Ursus...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Ursus... that's good too. Yes.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Why have you come to Kjerag, then?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright, stick to what you're doing.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: No, actually, that's enough. Too much is suspicious.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The girl? It's a long story. I'll tell you over dinner or something. Talk to you later.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright? Satisfied?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: For now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Are you sure the Trilby Asher didn't find anything else?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No need to be paranoid, Gnosis.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The Duke would not stay put if things had gotten to the point that you fear they have.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Don't forget the troops stationed in the foothills. Craigavon is no pushover.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: A Trilby Asher showing up on the train indicates that they've sensed something.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I have had dealings with the Trilby Ashers. On the surface, they are the groveling servants of the nobles, armed with nothing but silvery tongues.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But we can't ignore the fact that they grew up in the embers of an empire at war.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Karma catching up to the two of you, maybe?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If we're talking about karma, then you won't get far yourself.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Of course I won't. Why wouldn't we suffer payback for delivering a young girl to a Victorian spy?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: She will distract the Trilby Asher. That's why we need the Victorians to believe that she is important.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Do not forget that there will be many eyes on this place, with Kjeragandr's statue complete and the ceremony about to begin.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We must all be careful.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I don't need you to remind me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Relax, I'll be careful. It's not a game we're playing here, after all. The Browntails couldn't pull out if we wanted to.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Or rather...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If I showed even the slightest hint that I wanted out today, I'm plenty sure I would suffer an 'unfortunate accident' tomorrow.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I see no reason to engage in speculation about the impossible.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This is for Kjerag. We can only go forward, not back.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But we can't hide this forever, Gnosis.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It's too big, with too many people involved.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Even if the Trilby Asher didn't run into the girl today, he might've run into a certain boy another day.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: He will find out, sooner or later.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enciodes better have a plan, or even the full authority of the Saintess and all Kjerag won't save his hide.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And if Victoria finds Karlan Trade to be more important, then we truly have no card to play.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's good for all of us that the Saintess and Enciodes have taken up different positions.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I guess I'd better cancel my family dinner tomorrow.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Since when are you a family woman?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Isn't that what Kjerag has always been about? Family, bloodlines. Old-fashioned, I guess, but...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The Saintess and Enciodes are siblings, aren't they?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I see... I see...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Your mother gave birth to you in Kjerag, but she brought you to Ursus while you were still small.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You came back all this way, praying before the statue of Kjeragandr and preparing to climb the mountain to fulfill your mother's last wish.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's the story, basically.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Good girl... good girl.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Smart, brave... and handsome too.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, shucks. Now you're just flattering me.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I'm not.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You're a blessing from Kjeragandr to your family!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, er...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I wouldn't say that... I guess you could say Mamochka was blessed.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But it has nothing to do with my papa, who might as well never have existed.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Ahem. Well...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Your father... hrm...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You don't know who he might be, do you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's strange.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka said I look a lot like my papa, and he's supposed to be the handsomest man in Kjerag. I thought finding him would be a piece of cake.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Could it be...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Maybe my dad was actually pretty ordinary, and beauty was all in the eye of the beholder?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: O-Of course not! That's not the case at all!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whoa! Why are you so excited all of a sudden?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But I figured that's the most reasonable explanation.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Ah... it's hard to explain.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, I'm in no hurry. We can talk about it later.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Are you familiar with these parts?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I can't say I know everything, but I do know a thing or two.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So you're familiar, then...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Do you know the best route up that mountain?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I hear it's a make-out point or something. Do I need to buy a ticket or...?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: No need for tickets.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Other than Karlan, the seat of the Saintess, all the mountains and rivers of Kjerag belong to the children of Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Who would have asked such a question in the Kjerag of the past?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: This was a much quieter place back then.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: No sightseeing spots, no attractions, few tourists. Faith was strong in the people, who respected the mountains, rivers, and lakes.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: It has become like this because Clan Silverash wanted to open up to the outside, and the Saintess chose not to intervene...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What's so bad about opening up?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Well, that's not for an old man like me to judge.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Are you climbing the mountain today?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hm... It's getting a little late.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm thinking about spending the night somewhere and climbing up first thing in the morning.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Any good hotels around here?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I have a few spare rooms, if it's a roof over your head you're looking for.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: That is, if you're willing to stay in my humble abode...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Of course! Let's go.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Thank you so much! Mamochka always said the people of Kjerag were warm and kind.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: N-Now, listen, girl!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Don't be so quick to accept an offer like that! You need to be careful!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What would you do if I had ulterior motives?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why are you angry when you're the one who offered?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I went through a lot in Ursus. I'm no pushover.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Don't be a fool!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: How would you protect yourself if your assailant was stronger than you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm not a fool...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, I know, you're worried about me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Actually, I'm not sure why, but I just felt... well...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I can't put it into words. I just had a feeling...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't think you'd hurt me.

steps.name: Burly Tschäggättä
steps.text: Did you find the mark?

steps.name: Pumped-Up Tschäggättä
steps.text: No. I scanned the island with binoculars, but I didn't see anyone.

steps.name: Burly Tschäggättä
steps.text: We're dealing with a master of disguise. He won't slip up so easily.

steps.name: Pumped-Up Tschäggättä
steps.text: Then why tell me to look?

steps.name: Burly Tschäggättä
steps.text: Just in case.

steps.name: Burly Tschäggättä
steps.text: Our mission is to follow the girl, make sure no harm comes to her, and avoid detection.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Tschäggättä still have a lot to learn about counter-reconnaissance.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But if the girl has encountered the former head of Clan Paleroche...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: And the Tschäggättä are here too...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: What's that—

steps.name: Pumped-Up Tschäggättä
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Burly Tschäggättä
steps.text: I'll take a look.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: (Imitates burdenbeast cry)

steps.name: Burly Tschäggättä
steps.text: Just a wild burdenbeast.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You never know when a trick might come in handy.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Eek— my back—

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Look, Enya.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Look more carefully!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: This statue...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's not right, is it? Doesn't look like Kjeragandr at all.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I thought it was alright.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It's not alright!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The face needs to be a little thinner, and the body...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That will do, Kjarr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's up to the people of Kjerag. The Kjeragandr standing here is the one that they want to worship.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You know there's not much can change on that front.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No more sighs.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Did you hear the girl, Kjarr?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The one with the loud voice?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Of course I did. Interesting one. Kind of makes sense, you know.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Not even Kjeragandr can read minds, if you don't pray out loud.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: People's minds are such complicated things. Who can tell what you're thinking if you don't put it into words?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Will you heed the plea of your humble handmaiden, Saintess?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: This statue—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya, Enya!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Not even if you beg.
